description: Browse the full catalog of OFR repo-market and money-market-fund mnemonics by name (e.g. "tri-party", "GCF", "corporate debt", "federal reserve") — use this to find the exact series behind ofr_repo_rates/ofr_mmf_holdings, or a raw mnemonic to pass to ofr_funding_anomaly. OFR publishes no live search API, so this is a name/mnemonic lookup table, not a live call.

query.description: Substring to match against the series name or mnemonic (case-insensitive). Omit to list everything in the chosen dataset.
